notifications.list.description: Page through the caller's side's notifications: the keyword matches title and content; filter by type, priority, target and published state. Requires notification.notifications.read.
notifications.get.description: Get a notification with its delivery targets. Requires notification.notifications.read.
notifications.create.description: Create a notification draft, optionally publishing it at once: role, department and user targets need at least one ID, and departments exist only on the tenant side. Requires notification.notifications.create, plus notification.notifications.publish to publish at once.
notifications.update.description: Replace a notification draft, including its targets; published notifications cannot be changed. Requires notification.notifications.update.
notifications.delete.description: Delete notifications in bulk; published ones also leave their recipients' inboxes. Requires notification.notifications.delete.
notifications.publish.description: Publish a draft: resolve the active recipients of the caller's side from its targets, write their inbox entries and push them in real time after commit; a notification is published only once. Requires notification.notifications.publish.
notifications.remind.description: Remind: push a published notification again to recipients who have not read it, or not confirmed it when confirmation is required. Requires notification.notifications.publish.
notifications.read_stats.description: Read statistics: recipients, read, unread and confirmed counts. Requires notification.notifications.read.
notifications.recipients.description: Page through the recipients of a published notification with their read and confirmation state; optionally only unread or unconfirmed ones. Requires notification.notifications.read.
inbox.list.description: Page through your own inbox on the current side (published and within their visibility window): the keyword matches title and content; filter by read state and type or show only pending items. Any signed-in user.
inbox.banners.description: Your unread banner notifications, shown at the top of the page. Any signed-in user.
inbox.popups.description: Your popup notifications not shown yet; each pops up once after sign-in. Any signed-in user.
inbox.mandatory.description: Your unread mandatory notifications; pages are blocked until they are read. Any signed-in user.
inbox.mark_read.description: Mark entries of your own inbox as read. Any signed-in user.
inbox.mark_all_read.description: Mark every visible unread entry of your inbox on the current side as read. Any signed-in user.
inbox.confirm.description: Confirm a notification in your inbox that asks for confirmation; it is marked read too. Any signed-in user.
inbox.mark_popup_shown.description: Record that one of your popup notifications has been shown so it does not pop up again. Any signed-in user.
inbox.delete.description: Delete entries from your own inbox; the notifications themselves are unaffected. Any signed-in user.
message_templates.list.description: Page through the message templates of the caller's side. Requires notification.message-templates.read.
message_templates.get.description: Get one of the message templates. Requires notification.message-templates.read.
message_templates.create.description: Create message templates on the caller's side; codes are unique per side. Requires notification.message-templates.create.
message_templates.update.description: Edit message templates; the code does not change. Requires notification.message-templates.update.
message_templates.delete.description: Delete message templates in bulk. Requires notification.message-templates.delete.
email_configs.list.description: Page through the email configurations of the caller's side. Requires notification.email-configs.read.
email_configs.get.description: Get one of the email configurations. Requires notification.email-configs.read.
email_configs.create.description: Create email configurations on the caller's side; codes are unique per side. Requires notification.email-configs.create.
email_configs.update.description: Edit email configurations; the code does not change. Requires notification.email-configs.update.
email_configs.set_default.description: Make an enabled entry of the email configurations the caller's side default used for sending. Requires notification.email-configs.update.
email_configs.delete.description: Delete email configurations in bulk. Requires notification.email-configs.delete.
sms_configs.list.description: Page through the SMS configurations of the caller's side. Requires notification.sms-configs.read.
sms_configs.get.description: Get one of the SMS configurations. Requires notification.sms-configs.read.
sms_configs.create.description: Create SMS configurations on the caller's side; codes are unique per side. Requires notification.sms-configs.create.
sms_configs.update.description: Edit SMS configurations; the code does not change. Requires notification.sms-configs.update.
sms_configs.set_default.description: Make an enabled entry of the SMS configurations the caller's side default used for sending. Requires notification.sms-configs.update.
sms_configs.delete.description: Delete SMS configurations in bulk. Requires notification.sms-configs.delete.
emails.list.description: Page through the email send records of the caller's side. Requires notification.emails.read.
emails.get.description: Get one of the email send records. Requires notification.emails.read.
emails.resend.description: Resend email send records: back to queued with the attempt count reset; queued and sending ones are rejected. Requires notification.emails.resend.
emails.cancel.description: Cancel queued email send records. Requires notification.emails.resend.
emails.delete.description: Delete email send records in bulk. Requires notification.emails.delete.
sms.list.description: Page through the SMS send records of the caller's side. Requires notification.sms.read.
sms.get.description: Get one of the SMS send records. Requires notification.sms.read.
sms.resend.description: Resend SMS send records: back to queued with the attempt count reset; queued and sending ones are rejected. Requires notification.sms.resend.
sms.cancel.description: Cancel queued SMS send records. Requires notification.sms.resend.
sms.delete.description: Delete SMS send records in bulk. Requires notification.sms.delete.
bot_configs.list.description: Page through the bot configurations of the caller's side. Requires notification.bot-configs.read.
bot_configs.get.description: Get one of the bot configurations. Requires notification.bot-configs.read.
bot_configs.create.description: Create bot configurations on the caller's side; codes are unique per side. Requires notification.bot-configs.create.
bot_configs.update.description: Edit bot configurations; the code does not change. Requires notification.bot-configs.update.
bot_configs.set_default.description: Make an enabled entry of the bot configurations the caller's side default used for sending. Requires notification.bot-configs.update.
bot_configs.delete.description: Delete bot configurations in bulk. Requires notification.bot-configs.delete.
telegram_bots.list.description: Page through the platform-hosted Telegram bots; tokens are never shown. Requires notification.telegram-bots.read.
telegram_bots.get.description: Get a Telegram bot. Requires notification.telegram-bots.read.
telegram_bots.create.description: Create a Telegram bot: names are unique and the token is stored encrypted; admins, the group allow-list and broadcast chats are comma-separated integer IDs, the command allow-list is comma-separated command names. Requires notification.telegram-bots.create.
telegram_bots.update.description: Edit a Telegram bot; leaving the token empty keeps it. Requires notification.telegram-bots.update.
telegram_bots.delete.description: Delete Telegram bots in bulk. Requires notification.telegram-bots.delete.
